daily_narrative.happened: Stocks sold off broadly, with the S&P 500 down 1.2%, Nasdaq down 1.3%, and VIX falling 6.9%; the move appears to reflect profit-taking after recent gains and a rotation away from high-beta growth. The data show a transition regime with growth lagging, while momentum and value lead over one month and defensives/industrials hold up better than communication services, consumer discretionary, and real estate.
